tools.name: search_data
tools.description: Search source profiles and discover reviewed execution contracts. Returns metadata only and does not call an upstream API.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run one allowlisted, bounded HTTPS GET contract and return extracted values, provenance, and an integrity receipt.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Recompute receipt and result hashes locally. This checks integrity, not whether the upstream source remains current.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "execute" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
